info.description:
Manages per-tenant entitlement sets for the XpertPMS commercial domain.

**Capabilities.** Plan-based limits · manual operator overrides · quota addon packs · trial profile assignment · drawdown recording · shortfall raise/resolve · plan catalog read-through.

**Route prefixes.** `/api/v1/internal/*` — in-mesh services (mTLS, no JWT). `/api/v1/tenants/*` — tenant-scoped JWT callers. `/api/v1/operator/*` — platform operators.

**Tenant isolation.** Every resource is scoped by `x-tenant-id`; cross-tenant reads are blocked by row-level security (RLS-1..RLS-6).

Every mutation echoes `record_version` for optimistic-locking (CONC-1).

consumed_tokens.description:
ConsumedTokens = total − remaining − refunded (drawn by usage). For an
expired or revoked pack it also includes the forfeited balance.

refunded_tokens.description: RefundedTokens is the sum of applied Billing refunds (refund ledger).

remaining_tokens.description: RemainingTokens is the effective, still-usable balance.

removable.description: Removable: active and nothing drawn — ENT-O5 DELETE would succeed.

total_tokens.description: TotalTokens is the original purchased/granted quantity; immutable.

addon_eligibility.description:
AddonEligibility reports per-resource eligibility for quota add-on purchases.
Billing reads llm_tokens in v1 for the BIL-ADD-1 check (BL-OQ-3).
